function: above_phy, p. 7: the DRL agent (NsHQPN) learns only the UAV flight speed and the ground-node service scheduling; RIS phases are computed outside the agent and transmit power is fixed (p. 4).
notes: Excluded as above_phy (first applicable code). p. 7: "The action space A = {v, } contains the flight velocity v of the UAV and the service scheduling" of the GN. The trajectory comes from the non-learned MICH convex-hull algorithm plus an ellipse fit by gradient descent (pp. 5-7). The RIS phase shift is not a DRL action: it is set in a separate step (Algorithm 3, step 10, p. 9) and p. 10 says "RIS can calculate the optimal phase shift"; p. 4: "P is the fixed transmission power of the UAV". So the learned decisions are UAV speed (trajectory) and per-slot user scheduling, both above the PHY; no power, resource, beam, or RIS decision is learned. no_learning does not apply because the proposed method is a DRL algorithm. Reviewer may confirm that per-slot ground-node selection is user scheduling rather than aerial-link resource allocation.
